svg.title: Spatial folds
svg.text: Spatial block cross-validation: 3.84 km blocks, 640 m buffers
v1 split pixels at random — neighbours leaked into the test set and inflated R² to 0.901.
test pixels sit next to training pixels
Honest R² dropped from 0.901 to ≈ 0.70 — and simple baselines turned out to be the bar to beat.
